network: Network error. Please check your connection.
unauthorized: You are not authorized to perform this action.
server: Server error. Please try again later.
noFlightsFound: No flights found. Please try a different date or enter the data manually.
lookupUnavailable: Flight search currently unavailable. Please enter the data manually.
lookupNotConfigured: No flight-data provider is configured, so no search was performed. Add an API key under Settings, or enter the flight manually.
lookupOutsideLiveWindow: This flight search is not available on the free providers. The free tier only covers live flights (today). For past or future flights, configure an Aviationstack Basic+ key in Settings, or enter the flight manually.
noFlightDataForDate: No flight data found for this flight on this date. Please double-check the flight number and date, or enter the flight manually.
noFlightDataApiGap: The data provider has no record of this flight on this date. Even with an API key configured, the API may not cover this flight — please enter the flight manually.
boardingPassError: Boarding pass could not be scanned. Please try again or enter the data manually.
missingAirports: Please select departure and arrival airports
missingTimes: Please enter departure and arrival times
saveFailed: Flight could not be saved. Please check your inputs.
apiKeyInfo: Note: An API key is required for automatic flight search.

backend.nonHistoricalNeedsTimes: For flights with status "Flown", "Scheduled" or "Cancelled", departure and arrival times must be set and the difference must be between -12h and +24h. If your date is one day off by mistake, correct it; or mark the flight as "Historical" if the times are unknown.
backend.noFieldToUpdate: At least one field must be provided to update.
